summary: Make https://ekodi.kr/ekodibiz/ekodimall the canonical public and admin hierarchy for EKODI Mall while preserving the internal tenant key ekodimall.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly requested EKODI collaboration and production completion of the EKODI Mall path change.
migrationPolicy: Update active links, routing, auth returns, discovery metadata, deployment verification and tenant domain metadata; historical migrations and amendments remain immutable. The former /ekodibiz/mall path receives a path-level 308 transition to the new canonical path.
authorityImpact: None. EKODI Mall remains an EKODIBIZ-owned operating tenant with the same tenant and capability boundaries.
rollbackPlan: Revert the route/config commit and domain metadata migration through the guarded release lane if production verification fails.
